newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal ups Continental Air view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal ups Continental Air view.

text.p: -- Gruntal airline analyst Steve Lewins said the firm raised Continental Airlines Inc's 1996 earnings view to $4.50 a share from $4.00 a share to reflect dilution accounting rules.

-- Gruntal also raised the 1997 earnings view to $4.00 a share from $3.75 a share. Lewins said the new estimate is based on the assumption that the average share base in 1997 will be less for accounting purposes than in 1996. Lewins also assumes that fully-taxed profits in 1997 will fall below partially-taxed profits in 1996.

-- Gruntal said many of Wall Streets' forecasts for Continental differ since there is much confusion about Continental's return to tax-paying status, dilutive and anti-dilutive accounting and financial leverage from a debt-to-revenue ration of about 110 percent.
-- Gruntal said Continental's increased Latin service should support its high single-digit capacity growth.

-- The airlines' fourth quarter 1996 results appear to be on plan. Also, Continental's efforts to improve revenue per available seat mile (RASM) seems to keeping the airline in the top of the industry for "RASM," Lewins said.
